description: One manual addition or edit of a punch, made by a person, with the reason code they gave. Append-only: it is the record behind the monthly change notice. Written only by alvoraa_portal.punch_change, and only while the organisation's notice switch is on.

fields.label: Punch
fields.description: The name of the Employee Checkin this is about. Kept as text and not as a link, so the row outlives the punch.

fields.label: Reason
fields.options:
Employee forgot to punch
Punch machine was down or offline
Wrong direction (in and out swapped)
Duplicate or accidental scan
Employee not yet enrolled on the machine
Employee was on approved duty away from the machine
Other (details are in the HR file)
fields.description: DRAFT LIST. Needs sign-off before the notice switch is ticked on any tenant (slice 088, 00b section 3.3).

fields.label: What changed
fields.description: One plain English sentence, the same words the printed notice uses.

name: Alvoraa Punch Change
